{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to neutral/negative (e.g., 0.00 → -0.20).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast, re-calibrate next period’s forecast toward historical mean.",
    "If sentiment history includes 0.33 or higher positive sentiment, slightly increase forecast but cap at 10% above recent 7-day average to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply smoothing: if true outcome is consistently below forecast, reduce forecast by 5-8% for next period to reflect downward drift."
  ]
}
